entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Prune data for netcoreapp2.1 and below contains Microsoft.NETCore.App, but it shouldn't #49917
  • CPM - Provide CentralPackagesFile like option #49914
  • Update GitHub bug template to use details for `dotnet --info` request #49912
  • `dotnet format` on simple `dotnet new console` takes ~5 seconds #49910
  • dotnet command fails when both x64 and x86 SDKs are installed on Windows #49907

Closed

  • Trim earlier versions of platform packages from NuGet graph #9807
    Backlog
  • Running file-based app using repo-local dotnet install performs restore for .proj file in root of repo #49790
    10.0.1xx
  • What is the expected path for ResolvePackageFileConflicts to work with repositories that build their own platforms #3335
    Discussion
